MINUTES
  City of La Habra Heights
  Special Meeting of the La Habra Heights Roads Advisory Committee
  February 5, 2018

Call to Order – Special Roads Advisory Committee Meeting

Opening Ceremonies

1.  Call Meeting to Order – At 6:30 p.m., Chair Laherty called the Regular Roads
  Advisory Committee meeting to order.

2.  Roll Call

Present: Chair Dennis Laherty, Committee Members Tony Donato, Brent Grebbien, Glen
Pedersen, John Richert, John Steele, and Donald Struble

Absent: Vice Chair Paul LoNigro

Also Present: City Manager Jarad Hildenbrand, Assistant City Manager Fabiola Huerta
and Public Works Specialist Grace Andres

3.  Flag Salute

4.  Public Comment

Consent Calendar

5.  Minutes: January 9, 2018 – Adjourned Regular Roads Advisory Committee
  Meeting

Action: Moved (Richert), seconded (Donato) and voted 7 – 0 (Absent LoNigro) to
approve.

  -------------------------------- End of Consent Calendar --------------------------------

  ITEM #5
DRAFT SPECIAL ROADS ADVISORY COMMITTEE MEETING
MINUTES  1  FEBRUARY 5, 2018
 Administrative Items

6.  Benefit Assessment District No. 7 Community Outreach and Education

Action: Moved by Committee consensus to hold Community Outreach and Education
meetings on the following dates:

  Saturday, March 17, 2018 at 9:00 a.m. at the Park
  Monday, March 26, 2018 at 6:30 p.m. at City Hall
  Saturday, April 14, 2018 at 9:00 a.m. at the Park.

  -------------------------------- End of Administrative Items --------------------------------

Adjourn Meeting – At 7:14 p.m., Chair Laherty adjourned the meeting.

Submitted for Committee Approval:

________________________________
Fabiola Huerta
Assistant City Manager

MINUTES  2  FEBRUARY 5, 2018
